integrity: Proof and standalone exact rational calculations are supplied. Finite randomized checks supplement rather than establish the universal claim. Research findings have not undergone independent mathematical validation.
scientific_limitations: Exact population moments, not statistical error bounds. Three points independently uniform on the entire Euclidean triangular perimeter, no restrictions on edge assignments, nondegenerate parent triangle. The one-point-per-side conditional law was previously studied and is not claimed as new. Historical priority requires further independent assessment.
title: Three area moments reconstruct a triangle from perimeter-uniform random inscribed triangles
